"This chart tracks cumulative bond purchases by the BCRA (Central Bank of the Argentine Republic) net of Treasury buybacks.

### **Chart Overview**
*   **Title:** BCRA Bond Purchases Net of Treasury Buyback
*   **Units:** Billions of AR$, cumulative
*   **Y-Axis:** Value from 0 to 12,000 (increments of 2,000)
*   **X-Axis:** Time from June 2022 (Jun-22) to March 2024 (Mar-24)

### **Key Data Points (Approximated from Visual Scale)**

| Time Period | Approximate Cumulative Value (Billions of AR$) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Jun-22** | 0 |
| **Jul-22** | ~1,200 |
| **Jan-23** | ~1,900 |
| **Apr-23** | ~2,100 |
| **Aug-23** | ~4,800 |
| **Oct-23** | ~7,500 |
| **Dec-23 (Peak)** | ~9,800 |
| **Jan-24 (Post-drop)** | ~7,000 |
| **Feb-24 (Low point)** | ~4,200 |
| **Mar-24 (End of chart)** | ~7,000 |

### **Trend Analysis**
*   **Initial Growth (Jun-22 to Oct-22):** A sharp initial spike in July 2022 followed by a flat period holding steady near 1,300.
*   **Moderate Increase (Nov-22 to Apr-23):** A steady, gradual climb reaching approximately 2,100 by April 2023.
*   **Accelerated Growth (May-23 to Dec-23):** The rate of cumulative purchases increased significantly, peaking at nearly 10,000 billion AR$ in late December 2023.
*   **High Volatility (Jan-24 to Mar-24):** The beginning of 2024 shows extreme fluctuations. There was a sharp drop to 7,000, followed by a sudden plunge in February to roughly 4,200, before a rapid rebound back to the 7,000 level by March 2024."
